views.errorText: The rest of the screen stays usable. If the error persists, pass these codes on.

list.loaded: {n} loaded, more as you read | {n} loaded, more as you read
list.error: The list « {name} » could not be read.
list.noneText: Nothing to show at these dates, or nothing you may read.
list.noneFilteredText: Remove or change a filter to widen the list.
list.declarationsFailed: The declared properties could not be read: {names} stays untyped
list.notRead: The list is not read without this filter. Remove its chip, or correct the address.
list.restarted: The cursor of the list was refused: the list starts again from the top.

record.error: {kind}: the record could not be read.
record.explanationError: The explanation could not be read.
record.explanationMasked: The value is masked: you lack its read right.
record.chain: Path walked, from the object to the origin:
record.propertiesError: The properties could not be read.
record.noPropertiesText: No property is set, inherited or inferred on this object.
record.contentError: The content could not be read.
record.noContentText: Nothing lies in this object at these dates.
record.historyError: The history could not be read.
record.occupancyError: The occupancy could not be read.

home.error: The counters of the dashboard could not be read.
home.chart: Changesets applied per day, over 30 days

topology.tree: Tree of the prefixes of the domain {name}
topology.chooseText: Choose a prefix of the tree: its content shows here.
topology.leaf: This object holds nothing; its record tells the rest.
topology.treeError: The tree of the prefixes could not be read.
topology.domainsError: The domains could not be read.
topology.domainMissingText: The domain of the address is not among those you read: the tree shows {name}.
topology.noDomainText: No domain you may read: the tree of the prefixes needs one.

anomalies.error: The anomalies could not be read.
anomalies.gapsError: The gaps could not be read.
anomalies.noneText: No rule reports a deviation on the objects you read.
anomalies.noneOf: No open anomaly on this object
anomalies.unreadableText: Anomalies are read by domain or by entity: those of an object outside any domain are not served. The list of the anomalies shows all those you read.
anomalies.partial: Only the first {n} pages of the anomalies of the domain were read for this object; the list of the anomalies, filtered by domain, tells the rest.
anomalies.acknowledgeText: The anomaly {rule} will be closed; the motive stays in the audit log.
anomalies.motiveMissing: Write the motive of the acknowledgement.
anomalies.notPresent: An anomaly is acknowledged at the present: go back to the present.

properties.valuesError: The values could not be read.
properties.countPartial: {n} read, others remain | {n} read, others remain
properties.partial: Part of the declared properties was not read (cap of pages reached, or a page refused); the filters of the lists know only these.
properties.error: The declared properties could not be read.

edit.askOpen: Not applied: finish or cancel {what} first; your input “{value}” is not kept.
edit.notNow: Not written: off the present, or without the right, nothing is written here.
edit.applyForbidden: Applying now takes {permission}: the change goes to the draft.
edit.network: The server could not be reached.

check.choice: Choose a value of the list: {values}.

edit.conflict: The object changed since you read it
edit.conflictText: Your input is kept; apply it again to write it on the new version.
edit.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this
edit.failed: The change did not go through

reason.missing: You may not apply it yourself: the change waits for a review.
reason.held: An approval policy holds the change: it waits for a review.

edit.unchanged: Nothing changed: there is nothing to write.
edit.readError: {kind}: the object to change could not be read.

why.past: Read only off the present: go back to the present to change it.
why.immutable: The domain of an object never changes after its creation (core.domain.immutable).
why.computed: A computed value: it does not change.
why.creation: Fixed at creation: it does not change.
why.moved: The parent changes by “Change parent…”, not in place.

move.title: Change parent: {kind} {name}
move.cycle: Target refused: {target} is the object moved or one of its descendants.
move.incompatible: Target refused: {target} cannot be its parent.
move.dated: Dated read: go back to the present to change parent.
